request: Build a small Jac web app for booking seats at events. An organizer creates events with a title, a date and a seat capacity. An attendee can book one seat per event and cancel their booking. The events page shows each event with its remaining seats. Keep the booking rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Booking reduces the event's remaining seats by one; booking a full event is rejected.
An attendee cannot book the same event twice.
Cancelling a booking frees its seat; cancelling a booking that does not exist is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
